title: Seoul backs possible Trump-Kim dialogue as APEC summit speculation mounts
caption:
Speculation is building around a potential meeting between Donald Trump and Kim Jong-un at the APEC summit in China. Seoul is watching closely to ensure they remain part of the conversation on peninsula security.
